action.option: Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up

brief_basis: Scope check: the unchanged dashboard chart is the designated source for annual peak-burden routing. Its year ticks increase left-to-right, count ticks increase upward, and the marker above 2018 is visibly the highest; peak-burden therefore maps to the 2018 route.

used_rules.basis: The visible chart has one common-scale yearly series, increasing year ticks and upward-increasing count ticks; the task explicitly requests routing the yearly peak-burden, and the 2018 marker is highest.
